data_description.ventilation_type: Type of ventilation system for calculating ventilation heat loss
data_description.ceiling_height: Average ceiling height for calculating building volume (default: 2.5m)
data_description.pv_east_wp: Total peak power of east-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_south_wp: Total peak power of south-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_west_wp: Total peak power of west-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_tilt: Tilt angle of PV panels (0=horizontal, 90=vertical, typical: 35°)

heating_curve_settings.title: Heating Curve Settings
heating_curve_settings.description: Configure heating curve and optimization parameters

data.k_factor: K-factor (COP decline per °C supply temp increase)

data_description.supply_temperature_sensor: Sensor that measures the heat pump supply temperature
data_description.k_factor: How much COP decreases per °C increase in supply temperature (typical: 0.01-0.11)
data_description.base_cop: Heat pump COP at 35°C supply temperature (typical: 3.5-5.0)
data_description.outdoor_temp_coefficient: How much COP increases per °C outdoor temperature rise (typical: 0.025-0.08)
data_description.cop_compensation_factor: Factor to adjust theoretical COP to actual system performance (typical: 0.8-1.2)
data_description.time_base: Time interval for optimization in minutes (default: 60)
data_description.indoor_temp_hysteresis: Temperature band around setpoint where heating modulates (default: 0.5°C)
data_description.indoor_temp_hysteresis_lower: How far below target temp before heat pump turns ON (default: 0.3°C)
data_description.indoor_temp_hysteresis_upper: How far above target temp before heat pump turns OFF (default: 0.5°C)
data_description.offset_delta_t: Minutes required per 1°C offset change. Lower = faster response (default: 10, range: 5-60)
data_description.heat_curve_min_outdoor: Minimum outdoor temperature for heating curve (default: -20°C)
data_description.heat_curve_max_outdoor: Maximum outdoor temperature for heating curve (default: 15°C)
data_description.heating_curve_offset: Manual offset to add to optimized heating curve (range: -4 to +4°C, default: 0)

data_description.pv_east_wp: Total peak power of east-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_south_wp: Total peak power of south-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_west_wp: Total peak power of west-facing PV panels in Wp
data_description.pv_tilt: Tilt angle of PV panels (0=horizontal, 90=vertical, typical: 35°)
